metadata.name: solclaw
metadata.description: Agent-to-Agent USDC payments by name on Solana

instructions.name: approve
docs: Approve another agent to pull USDC from your vault, up to `amount`.
If an allowance already exists, this REPLACES the amount (not adds to it).

instructions.name: batch_payment
docs: Batch pay multiple agents in one transaction.
v3: Added memo support per payment entry

instructions.name: cancel_invoice
docs: Cancel a pending invoice. Only the requester (creator) can cancel.

instructions.name: cancel_subscription
docs: Cancel a subscription. Only the sender (authority) can cancel.

instructions.name: create_invoice
docs: Create a payment request (invoice).
The requester asks the payer for a specific amount.

instructions.name: create_subscription
docs: Create a new recurring payment subscription

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit USDC into the agent's vault

instructions.name: execute_subscription
docs: Execute a due subscription payment. ANYONE can call this (permissionless crank).
v3: Added spending cap check and auto-generated memo

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone can crank — no authority constraint

instructions.name: increase_allowance
docs: Increase an existing allowance by a given amount.

instructions.name: init_invoice_counter
docs: Initialize the global invoice counter. Call once after program deploy.

instructions.name: pay_invoice
docs: Pay a pending invoice. Only the designated payer can call this.
Transfers USDC and marks the invoice as paid in one atomic TX.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The payer's wallet

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Register a new agent with a human-readable name
Creates a PDA vault for USDC storage

instructions.name: reject_invoice
docs: Reject a pending invoice. Only the designated payer can reject.

instructions.name: revoke_allowance
docs: Revoke an allowance. Only the owner can revoke.

instructions.name: set_daily_limit
docs: Set or remove a daily spending limit for an agent.
Only the agent's authority can call this.
Set to 0 to remove the limit.

instructions.name: split_payment
docs: Split a total USDC amount across multiple agents proportionally.
v3: Added memo support

instructions.name: transfer_by_name
docs: Transfer USDC from sender vault to receiver vault by name
v3: Added optional memo parameter

instructions.name: transfer_from
docs: Pull USDC from an owner's vault using an approved allowance.
The SPENDER calls this (not the owner).

accounts.name: spender_authority
docs: The spender's wallet — they initiate the pull

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw USDC from vault to user's token account

errors.name: InvalidNameLength
errors.msg: Name must be between 1 and 32 characters

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized: you don't control this vault

errors.name: InvalidRemainingAccounts
errors.msg: Wrong number of remaining accounts for batch/split

errors.name: NameMismatch
errors.msg: Recipient name does not match registry

errors.name: VaultMismatch
errors.msg: Vault does not match agent registry

errors.name: InvalidSplitShares
errors.msg: Split shares must add up to 10000 basis points

errors.name: InvalidInterval
errors.msg: Subscription interval must be at least 60 seconds

errors.name: SpendingCapExceeded
errors.msg: Transfer would exceed daily spending limit

errors.name: InvoiceNotPending
errors.msg: Invoice is not in pending status

types.name: Allowance
docs: v3: Allowance account for approve/transferFrom pattern

types.name: AllowanceApprovedEvent
docs: v3: Allowance approved event

types.name: AllowanceModifiedEvent
docs: v3: Allowance modified event

types.name: AllowanceRevokedEvent
docs: v3: Allowance revoked event

types.name: BatchPaymentEntry
docs: A single payment entry within a batch
v3: Added optional memo

fields.name: recipient_name
docs: The name of the recipient agent

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount in USDC smallest units (6 decimals)

fields.name: memo
docs: Optional memo (max 128 bytes)

types.name: BatchPaymentEvent
docs: v3: Batch payment event with memos

types.name: DailyLimitSetEvent
docs: v3: Daily limit set event

types.name: Invoice
docs: v4: On-chain payment request.
Created by the requester, paid by the payer.

fields.name: id
docs: Unique invoice ID (derived from global counter)

fields.name: requester
docs: The agent requesting payment (AgentRegistry PDA)

fields.name: payer
docs: The agent who should pay (AgentRegistry PDA)

fields.name: requester_name
docs: Requester's readable name (max 32)

fields.name: payer_name
docs: Payer's readable name (max 32)

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount requested in USDC smallest units

fields.name: memo
docs: Description / reason for the invoice (max 128)

fields.name: status
docs: Current status: 0=Pending, 1=Paid, 2=Rejected, 3=Cancelled, 4=Expired

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Expiry timestamp. 0 = never expires.

fields.name: paid_at
docs: Timestamp when paid (0 if not yet paid)

fields.name: authority
docs: The authority who created this (requester's wallet)

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

types.name: InvoiceCancelledEvent
docs: v4: Invoice cancelled event

types.name: InvoiceCounter
docs: v4: Global counter for generating unique invoice IDs.
Single PDA for the entire program, seeded by ["invoice_counter"].

types.name: InvoiceCreatedEvent
docs: v4: Invoice created event

types.name: InvoicePaidEvent
docs: v4: Invoice paid event

types.name: InvoiceRejectedEvent
docs: v4: Invoice rejected event

types.name: SplitPaymentEvent
docs: v3: Split payment event with memo

types.name: SplitRecipient
docs: A split recipient with their share in basis points

fields.name: name
docs: Agent name

fields.name: share_bps
docs: Share in basis points (5000 = 50%)

types.name: SubscriptionExecutedEvent
docs: v3: Subscription executed event with auto-memo

types.name: TransferEvent
docs: v3: Transfer event with memo

types.name: TransferFromEvent
docs: v3: TransferFrom event
